candidates.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation from Raw Nerve Conduction Waveforms to Point-of-Care B-Mode Ultrasound (EDX2US-KD)
candidates.summary: Distill functional electrophysiological representations from a teacher network trained on raw motor/sensory NCS spectrograms into an ultrasound-only student network so B-mode wrist ultrasound alone predicts 4-level functional CTS severity.
candidates.hypothesis: Aligning intermediate B-mode ultrasound embeddings with STFT/wavelet representations of paired motor and sensory nerve conduction waveforms via contrastive relational distillation will improve 4-grade CTS severity classification (especially mild vs. moderate demyelination) by >=5% macro-F1 over ultrasound-only CNNs trained on discrete severity labels alone.
candidates.mve: Train a 2D-CNN teacher on STFT motor/sensory NCS waveforms and a ResNet/ConvNeXt student on paired B-mode ultrasound (5-fold CV on the 55-patient Shanghai Sixth Hospital paired US+EMG dataset + synthetic SNR perturbations), comparing hard-label CE vs. cross-modal feature + logit distillation.

candidates.title: Anatomical-Graph Neural Network over Carpal Tunnel Structure Topology (CarpalGraph-Net)
candidates.summary: Model the median nerve, flexor retinaculum, and nine flexor tendons as an interacting spatial-biomechanical graph rather than an isolated nerve ROI.
candidates.hypothesis: A relational graph neural network operating on segmented node features (median nerve, flexor tendons, retinaculum bowing angle, and tunnel crowding ratio) will outperform isolated median-nerve CNNs and CSA cutoffs on atypical/bifid nerve cases and mild CTS.
candidates.mve: Extract multi-structure masks/keypoints using a pre-trained segmentation backbone on transverse carpal tunnel ultrasound frames, construct a k-NN anatomical graph, and compare a 3-layer GATv2 classifier against isolated median-nerve ResNet-50 and CSA cutoffs.

candidates.title: Disentangled Morphology-vs-Echotexture Network with Intra-Patient Comparative Normalization (MorphoTex-CTS)
candidates.summary: Resolve the literature contradiction between geometric CSA cutoffs and CSA-free texture CNNs by explicitly disentangling nerve shape/size from intraneural fascicular echotexture normalized against internal reference tissue.
candidates.hypothesis: Explicitly factorizing carpal tunnel ultrasound representations into a shape-only branch (silhouette mask geometry) and a shape-invariant texture branch (masked intraneural + epineurial texture normalized via cosine similarity to reference muscle/tendon echogenicity) with orthogonality regularization will reveal that texture dominates early/mild CTS while geometry dominates moderate/severe CTS, and their gated fusion will beat both CSA-only and CSA-free models.
candidates.mve: On transverse B-mode ultrasound images, train a dual-branch network (Branch A: binary mask shape encoder; Branch B: masked ROI texture encoder with gradient-reversal/orthogonality against CSA) and evaluate stage-wise AUROC across normal, mild, moderate, and severe CTS.

candidates.title: Spatiotemporal Kinematic-Deformation Transformer on Dynamic Cine-Loop Ultrasound (GlideFormer-CTS)
candidates.summary: Jointly model median nerve trajectory kinematics (radial-ulnar/dorsal-palmar excursion velocity) and continuous cross-sectional circularity/strain deformation across finger flexion-extension cine loops.
candidates.hypothesis: Combining optical-flow-guided nerve center-of-mass trajectory kinematics with frame-to-frame boundary strain/deformation tokens in a lightweight temporal Transformer will detect subclinical subsynovial connective tissue tethering in mild CTS where static CSA is normal (<10 mm2).
candidates.mve: Run U-Net/YOLOv8-seg across dynamic wrist/finger flexion ultrasound video sequences to extract per-frame nerve masks, compute displacement velocity + boundary Fourier descriptor strain series, and compare a temporal Transformer against static single-frame CSA and YOLOv5 centroid-only tracking.

candidates.title: Physics-Guided Speckle-Invariant Test-Time Adaptation for Cross-Vendor Carpal Tunnel Ultrasound (SpeckleTTA)
candidates.summary: Challenge the assumption of i.i.d. ultrasound acquisition by adapting segmentation and diagnostic networks at test time using physics-based acoustic speckle statistics and contour-entropy minimization.
candidates.hypothesis: Updating batch-norm / adapter parameters at test time via Rayleigh/Nakagami acoustic backscatter consistency and boundary-entropy minimization will recover >=60% of the Dice and AUROC degradation caused by cross-probe frequency, gain, and compression shifts.
candidates.mve: Simulate realistic physics-based acoustic shifts (speckle scale, TGC depth attenuation, probe compression axial deformation) and cross-center splits; benchmark source-only U-Net/ResNet vs. Tent vs. SpeckleTTA during single-patient inference.

candidates.title: Conformal Risk-Controlled Deferral for Two-Stage Non-Invasive-to-EDX Clinical Triage (ConformalCTS-Gate)
candidates.summary: Replace fixed probability thresholds in clinical/ultrasound screening with split conformal prediction sets that guarantee a user-specified false-negative ceiling (<2%) while minimizing invasive NCS referrals.
candidates.hypothesis: Wrapping a multimodal non-invasive classifier (anthropometrics + BCTQ symptoms + B-mode US) in a stage-conditional conformal risk controller will eliminate invasive electrodiagnostic testing in >=45% of patients while provably bounding missed moderate/severe CTS below 2%.
candidates.mve: Train XGBoost + US-CNN ensemble on clinical + ultrasound features, calibrate split conformal prediction sets at alpha = 0.02 and 0.05 across bootstrap folds, and measure the fraction of singleton predictions (confident non-invasive triage) vs. multi-label abstentions (referred to NCS).

candidates.title: Cross-Anatomy Peripheral Nerve Self-Supervised Pre-Training for Few-Shot Median Nerve Segmentation (NerveMAE)
candidates.summary: Pre-train a speckle-aware Masked Autoencoder on large public peripheral nerve ultrasound collections (brachial plexus, sciatic, femoral, median nerves) to enable high-accuracy median nerve segmentation and CTS grading with <=20 labeled wrists.
candidates.hypothesis: Self-supervised masked acoustic patch reconstruction across heterogeneous peripheral nerve ultrasound datasets (e.g., Kaggle 5,635-image Brachial Plexus + public nerve videos) will enable a fine-tuned median nerve segmentation and diagnosis head to match full-supervision performance using only 10-20% labeled CTS wrists.
candidates.mve: Pre-train a lightweight ViT/ConvNeXt-MAE on the public Kaggle Ultrasound Nerve dataset (5,635 images) with speckle-tube masking, then fine-tune on 5, 10, 20, and 50 labeled carpal tunnel ultrasound images and compare Dice/AUROC against ImageNet-pretrained U-Net/Mask R-CNN.

candidates.title: Foundation 3D-Volume Carpal Tunnel Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Freehand 2D Ultrasound Sweeps
candidates.summary: Train an implicit neural representation (NeRF/Gaussian splatting) with inertial/speckle decorrelation priors to reconstruct 3D volumetric median nerve geometry from 2D freehand wrist sweeps.
candidates.hypothesis: 3D volumetric nerve constriction ratio (hourglass index across the entire carpal tunnel length) reconstructed from uncalibrated 2D sweeps will outperform single-slice inlet CSA.
candidates.mve: Fit a neural implicit volume to sequential 2D transverse sweep frames and estimate longitudinal cross-sectional profile.

candidates.title: Shortcut Auditing & Frequency-Band Attribution in Ultrasound and NCS Deep Learning Classifiers (CTS-ShortcutAudit)
candidates.summary: Systematically audit whether high-accuracy CTS ultrasound CNNs (>95% reported accuracy) and NCS spectrogram CNNs rely on true neurophysiological/anatomical biomarkers or spurious imaging/signal shortcuts.
candidates.hypothesis: Masking tests (nerve-only vs. background-only vs. bounding-box-erased images) and spatial-frequency band ablations will show that standard unconstrained CNNs trained on small CTS ultrasound datasets derive >35% of their discriminative signal from non-nerve depth/gain/transducer artifacts rather than median nerve pathology.
candidates.mve: Train standard ResNet-50 / DenseNet-121 / ViT classifiers on four image variants: (1) full image, (2) nerve-ROI only, (3) background-only with median nerve zeroed out, and (4) phase-randomized speckle; quantify shortcut reliance and evaluate an anatomical-attention-constrained loss that eliminates background shortcut leakage.

candidates.title: Counterfactual Individual Treatment Effect (ITE) Estimation for Conservative vs. Needle Release vs. Open Carpal Tunnel Release
candidates.summary: Learn calibrated counterfactual outcome curves predicting 6-month BCTQ symptom resolution under conservative splinting, US-guided needle release, and open surgical release.
candidates.hypothesis: Causal representation learning (TARNet/DragonNet) on multimodal pre-treatment features will identify the subgroup of moderate CTS patients who achieve equivalent recovery from minimally invasive needle release vs. open surgery.
candidates.mve: Fit DragonNet on retrospective multi-arm clinical cohort data with propensity weighting.
